# Search for FixedTzOffset more broadly
r = await CONTEXT.search("FixedTzOffset")
for item in r.get('items', []):
    offset = item['offset']
    text = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, offset - 100), 400)
    print(f"offset={offset}: {text}")
    print("---")

# Also search for 'D' type (R5)
r2 = await CONTEXT.search("'D'")
for item in r2.get('items', []):
    offset = item['offset']
    if offset > 150000 and offset < 240000:
        text = await CONTEXT.read(max(0, offset - 100), 400)
        print(f"'D': offset={offset}: {text[:300]}")
        print("---")
